crowdRule.note: Original uses comesBeforeValInList; preserve its threshold comparator from VeryGeneral before deciding exact boundary equality.

ui.note: DateDisplayScript explicitly plays Tick.wav at date update; DlgEventCardAncestor plays _EventCard at open. No generic button-click/error audio reference established in the inspected DialogButtonScript and category paths; do not invent mappings.

publisher.note: getSpeechFile has no Publish branch; DlgPublishScript inspected has music preview but no character greeting. No publisher voice mapped.

observations: SWA headers are MPEG1 LayerIII audio, not a proprietary sound container. Browser MP3 extension changes no bytes. Files provide5 variants while getSpeechFile greetings choose1..3. Action suffixZ requests1..5.
